svg.aria-label: Architecture of hr-attrition-power-bi. Sources: Excel workbook (sheet WA_Fn-UseC_-HR-Employee-Attriti). Inside Power BI (.pbix), 3 stages left to right. Power Query: Staging query employees_staging; Load Excel.Workbook, the sheet, Promote headers; Clean Type 35 columns, Drop 3 constant columns, Add AttritionFlag (Yes = 1); Shape Dims: distinct values, Index surrogate keys, Fact: 7 key lookups. Data Model: Tables 8 (import); Fact fact_employee; Dimensions 7; Relationships 7, many-to-one, Single direction. DAX: Measures 15 in _Measures; Headcount, leavers, rate, 1.5 x IQR outliers, High-risk employees; Calculated columns 7; Age, tenure, income bands, Risk Flags (6 flags). Report: Power BI report, Report pages, pages Home, 1-Overview, 2-Drivers, 3-Trends & Outliers. Report: SQL check, sql/attrition_by_department.sql, leavers per department.
svg.title: hr-attrition-power-bi high level architecture
